## Execution tips

- Consider gripping a flat wall section below the small bin opening on the robot side, with one finger inside and one against the outside. Open slightly wider than the local wall thickness to avoid hitting the rim while trying to span the whole opening.
- Before closing, confirm that both fingers are on the inside and outside of the bin wall with enough pad contact, rather than grasping only a sharp rim edge that could slip during pouring.
- Keep the bucket opening upward and move smoothly during transport, leaving clearance between the bottom and table or edge to reduce balls rolling out prematurely or the bucket body hitting something.
- Move the small bucket opening beyond the large bin's table-side edge, facing inward, with rotation room for bucket and wrist. This reduces rim collisions and balls bouncing out after hitting an edge.
- If balls remain inside, make a small tilt adjustment or gentle shake while keeping the bucket opening facing into the large bucket. Avoid large swings that could send a ball out of the target area.
